observations: Two black game consoles are shown side-by-side on a glass counter.
The console on the right has a matte finish and a visible PlayStation logo on the top surface.
The console on the left has a glossy finish and a visible 'SONY' logo on the top surface.
Both units appear to be the same model as the one in the seller's description.
The background shows retail shelves with various electronic devices and boxes.
Watermarks for 'McSteve' and 'Jiji' are present on both images.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: The console in photo 0 has a matte finish and a PlayStation logo, which is characteristic of the PS4 Pro model.
No controller is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty optical disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a disc being read.

risks.risk: The console may have a faulty HDMI port or other input/output ports.
risks.proof: A video showing a game being connected via HDMI and the screen displaying it.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console successfully logging into the PSN store.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the home menu.
Video of a game disc being inserted and recognized by the console.
Screenshot of the console connected to the internet and logged into the PlayStation Store.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
